n, m, mod = map(int, input().split())

# Initialize arrays
g = [0] * 505
sg = [0] * 505
f = [[0] * 505 for _ in range(505)]
sf = [[0] * 505 for _ in range(505)]
C = [[0] * 505 for _ in range(505)]

def add(a, b):
    return a + b - mod if a + b >= mod else a + b

def sub(a, b):
    return a - b + mod if a < b else a - b

def compute_C():
    C[0][0] = 1
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        C[i][0] = 1
        for j in range(1, i + 1):
            C[i][j] = add(C[i - 1][j], C[i - 1][j - 1])

def sum_series(x):
    return (x * (x + 1) // 2) % mod

compute_C()

g[0] = 1
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        tmp = (g[j - 1] * g[i - j] % mod) * C[i - 1][j - 1] % mod
        g[i] = add(g[i], tmp * (i + 1))
        sg[i] = add(sg[i], sg[j - 1] * g[i - j] % mod * C[i - 1][j - 1] % mod * (i + 1))
        sg[i] = add(sg[i], sg[i - j] * g[j - 1] % mod * C[i - 1][j - 1] % mod * (i + 1))
        sg[i] = add(sg[i], tmp * (sum_series(i - j) + sum_series(j - 1)))

for i in range(n + 1):
    f[i][0] = 1

for i in range(1, n + 1):
    if i <= m:
        f[i][i] = g[i]
        sf[i][i] = sg[i]
    for j in range(1, min(i, m) + 1):
        for t in range(i, 0, -1):
            if i - t > j:
                break
            tmp = g[i - t] * C[j][i - t] % mod
            f[i][j] = add(f[i][j], f[t - 1][j - i + t] * tmp)
            sf[i][j] = add(sf[i][j], sf[t - 1][j - i + t] * tmp)
            sf[i][j] = add(sf[i][j], f[t - 1][j - i + t] * sg[i - t] % mod * C[j][i - t])

print(sf[n][m])
